raw_error_definition: DFT relative energy minus GFN2 relative energy

record.relative_energy_threshold_basis: Existing 0.5 meV/atom criterion converted to 1.5 meV/CH2 (3 atoms per CH2), applied separately to relative-energy differences. This alone does not resolve sub-meV endpoint ordering.
record.numerical_uncertainty_note: Observed finite-precision difference on four declared points, not a statistical confidence bound; retain separately from model sigma.

thresholds.residual_force_requirement: not imposed; initial geometries are not optimized
thresholds.stress_requirement: recorded only; no new stress threshold invented

record.scope_note: Only the listed frozen PE geometries were tested. This gate does not prove convergence for every candidate or a different cell/phase.

relative_energy_sampling.acceptance_role: diagnostic; no additional tolerance is silently imposed

numerical_uncertainty.handling: Read and retain reported relative-to-R0 changes; numerical uncertainty is not converted to a fitted sigma or hidden by a near-zero residual.
numerical_uncertainty.screening_margin_validated_definition: Independent predictive coverage; does not block the scoped empirical margin.

scope.chain: Same all-trans chain construction as the frozen initial samples

empirical_scoped_calibration.error_definition: e_i = DeltaE_DFT_i - DeltaE_GFN2_i, each relative to R0
empirical_scoped_calibration.bias_definition: Arithmetic mean of the 16 initial relative-energy errors
empirical_scoped_calibration.interpretation: The bias and empirical 3-sigma margin describe this fixed-cell initial-angle domain. They are usable within that declared scope without a population coverage claim. Do not transfer them to the four optimized endpoints.

initial_domain_calibration.domain: fixed-cell rigid-chain initial angular grid only
initial_domain_calibration.reference: Relative to the declared fixed final_group_001 geometry
initial_domain_calibration.split_strategy: Leave one contiguous angular block out
initial_domain_calibration.production_sigma_validated_definition: Independent predictive coverage validation; separate from the accepted scoped empirical sigma.
initial_domain_calibration.role: Supplementary diagnostic; no acceptance gate for empirical_scoped_calibration.
